description:
FILED s473t2 (Opus triage of the 152 causeless blessed sweep rows), on main 0d783d24.
Probes scratch/s473t2/probes/p11-misc.pl G, p13-pool.pl, p5-magic.pl D.
Seven independent shapes; each is one blessed sweep row.  Split off any of them
that grows a second consumer.

1. `${::}{NAME}` -- the main-stash shorthand -- is emitted as a CALL.
   perl-tests/local.t 306 ("[perl #52740]").
     eval q{ use constant kk => q(a); my $s = ${::}{kk}; print "ok"; 1 }
   perl: ok      PCL: The function main::|pl-main::| is undefined.
   (`${main::}{NAME}` is the same thing spelled out; only the `::` shorthand was
   probed as failing.)

2. A FILETEST followed by `//` does not parse.  perl-tests/dor.t 23
   ("-f // ... compiles"), a census-visible #138 drop:
     eval q{ -f // 0; 1 }
   perl: compiles   PCL: statement dropped -- "Bug. Fell through. Missing case:
   [prefix_op, Token::Number<0>]".  `-f` alone and `-f $_ // 0` both work, so it
   is the $_-default pre-pass meeting the `//` operator.

3. `goto LABEL` into a foreach leaks an SBCL compile error instead of dying like
   perl.  perl-tests/eval.t 45 ("eval catches bad goto calls"):
     eval { eval { goto foo }; print $@; last; foreach my $i (1) { foo: ... } }
   perl: Can't "goto" into the middle of a foreach loop
   PCL : Execution of a form compiled with errors. Form: (go :foo)
         Compile-time error: attempt to GO to nonexistent tag: :foo
   The value is trapped ($@ is set), so the program continues -- but the text is
   an SBCL artifact, and a `goto` whose label is not reachable should be PCL's
   own die.

4. A FULLY QUALIFIED method name is not split, so dispatch runs in the invocant's
   package.  perl-tests/method.t 34/35 (behind the collapsed unnamed key
   `method.t 111`):
     $e = bless {}, "E::F"; eval 'UNIVERSAL->E::F::foo()'
   perl: Can't locate object method "foo" via package "E::F" at ...
   PCL : Can't locate object method "E::F::foo" via package "UNIVERSAL" at ...
   The plain `$obj->foo` message is correct (probed), so this is only the
   qualified-name form -- and the wrong message means the wrong LOOKUP, so a
   method that DOES exist in E::F would be missed.

5. A glob's HASH slot is true where perl has none.  perl-tests/magic.t 85
   ("no %@"):  ok !*@{HASH}
   perl: true (there is no %@)      PCL: false (the slot answers something)

6. Freeing a self-referential typeglob type-errors.  perl-tests/ref.t 130
   ("freeing self-referential typeglob"): got
     The value "Symbol::" is not of type hash-table
   NB it does NOT fail in the current single-file sweep on 0d783d24 (ref.t's row
   numbering has moved and this row is not in the run's fail list) -- verify
   before working on it.

7. 64K-deep recursion exhausts SBCL's BINDING stack and aborts the image.
   perl-tests/recurse.t 27 ("64K deep recursion - no output expected"): got
     "Binding stack guard page unprotected ... sb-kernel::binding-stack-exhausted".
   Reproduced at 20,000 frames already (p13-pool.pl G kills the run), so the
   limit is well below perl's.  A depth limit is legitimate; aborting the whole
   image with an SBCL backtrace is not.

ALSO CAUSED HERE, NOT A BUG: perl-tests/split.t 32 is
`runperl(switches => ['-Dt'], prog => '($a,$b)=split;')` and asserts the child
printed either "DEBUGGING" (the non-debugging perl's refusal) or a `-Dt` op
dump.  tools/pclperl-for-tests ignores `-D` and prints neither, so the row can
only pass if PCL answers `-D` somehow.  It passes under tools/runt, where the
child is the REAL perl.  Recorded here so the row is not re-derived.
subject: POOL (s473t2): seven unowned one-row shapes found by the causeless-rows triage, each probed vs perl 5.40.3 -- a stash shorthand and a filetest-plus-// that are DROPPED, a `goto` that leaks an SBCL compile error, a qualified method name that dispatches in the wrong package, a glob HASH slot that is true, a freed typeglob that type-errors, and 64K-deep recursion
